title: Big and Little Kato, Ornest Caress and White Newman
summary: The Katos were father and son; he rates White Newman and Ornest Caress among the best of the time, with an exchange about Newman's son.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel
